functions.name: pull_requests
functions.description: Selected pull requests at stable repository/number grain. Repository, owner or organization lists current PRs; user/users and label scopes discover then hydrate full PR responses. Explicit repository/number lookup also returns full detail. Repository and author selection intersect. Common identity, branch/repository snapshots and state fields are retained across routes. Full-response counters and mergeability remain NULL on list routes; no extra per-PR requests are added. Embedded milestone/auto-merge records are snapshots, not complete relationship populations.

metrics.name: pull_request_count
metrics.comment: All selected open and closed PR records; each PR counts once regardless of reviews.

metrics.name: merged_prs
metrics.comment: PRs with a merge timestamp, including bots and draft waiting time.

metrics.name: median_merge_hours
metrics.comment: Exact continuous median elapsed UTC hours from PR creation to merge. NULL for an empty merged cohort; independent of review multiplicity.

metrics.name: pull_request_active_days
metrics.comment: Distinct UTC creation dates represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across repositories and other overlapping groups; inactive dates contribute zero.

metrics.name: pull_request_repository_count
metrics.comment: Distinct known repository identities represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across dates/categories; unknown repository context is excluded.

metrics.name: pull_request_detail_observation_count
metrics.comment: Selected PRs retrieved through a full-response route with reported detail counters. List-only observations are excluded.

derived_fields.name: merge_hours
derived_fields.comment: Elapsed UTC milliseconds between creation and merge divided by 3600000; NULL until merged.

derived_fields.name: pull_request_created_day
derived_fields.comment: Gregorian UTC calendar date of PR creation, independent of the client's local timezone.

derived_fields.name: pull_request_merged_day
derived_fields.comment: Gregorian UTC calendar date of PR merge; NULL for unmerged PRs. Date filters define a merge cohort, not a creation cohort.

derived_fields.name: pull_request_created_week
derived_fields.comment: UTC Gregorian week of creation; weeks begin Monday.

derived_fields.name: pull_request_created_month
derived_fields.comment: UTC Gregorian month of creation; weeks begin Monday.

derived_fields.name: pull_request_title_category
derived_fields.comment: Transparent classification from case-insensitive conventional title prefixes docs:, fix:, feat:, refactor:, test:. First matching rule wins; other titles are unclassified. This describes title wording, not author intent; original title is available as evidence.

pull_request_reported_comment_count.comment: Sum of reported issue comments on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.

pull_request_reported_review_comment_cou.comment: Sum of reported review comments on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.

pull_request_reported_commit_count.comment: Sum of reported included commits on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.

pull_request_reported_additions.comment: Sum of reported added lines on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.

pull_request_reported_deletions.comment: Sum of reported deleted lines on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.

pull_request_reported_changed_file_count.comment: Sum of reported changed files on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.
